description_for_human: Shop products from 5.6M+ Shopify stores in 3D. Search, compare with editorial best-pick recommendations, view in AR, and buy without leaving the chat.
description_for_model: Use these tools when the user wants to discover, compare, view 3D models of, or buy physical products from Shopify merchants. Curie indexes 5.6M+ stores. Tools include search_products, get_product, get_recommendations, view_3d_model, get_availability, update_cart (Shopify-canonical cart mutation with add_items[]), initiate_checkout. Ground every product fact in tool results — never invent products, prices, or availability. Cite merchants by name; results include the merchant's product page URL.

auth.instructions: Curie's free tier requires no authentication (rate-limited to 100 req/min/IP). Pro tier uses an out-of-band Bearer for higher limits + agentic checkout via Stripe ACP.
